jobSummary: As an Operation Supervisor, you will oversee the Worldcoin project activation site, ensuring smooth daily operations and acting as the point of contact for any technical issues. You will apply guidance from the Operator and be responsible for troubleshooting and reporting technical problems to Worldcoin Support.
keyResponsibilities: Plan and manage work schedules and shifts to ensure smooth daily operations
Conduct training sessions and ensure staff understanding of Worldcoin project and Orb verification process
Track individual staff performance and conduct regular performance reviews
Oversee daily operations and handle customer inquiries
Lead and motivate the team to achieve collective goals
Handle last-minute changes, staff absences, and shift adjustments
Maintain a professional, friendly, and efficient service environment
Act as the main point of contact between staff and management
qualifications: Must understand and speak basic English
Experience in leading a team or working as a supervisor in retail, hospitality, or customer service
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks
Able to work under pressure and handle operational challenges effectively
Friendly, hardworking, and proactive
Willing to work in shift-based schedules as required

compensation.performanceBonus: Performance bonus based on site performance metrics and operational targets

additionalNote: Both positions are employed under our company (Koru Indonesia) for the Worldcoin project, not directly hired by Worldcoin.
